label: SCG I.22 accident not quiddity of identified esse bearer
paraphrase: OPEN selected reading of the first case of SCG I.22 n.4, attribution deferred: when bearer x is ontically identified with its esse e, a q accidental to that e cannot be x's genuine quiddity. Identification is a separately interpreted predicate and not extensional co-presence or q.3 Profile equality. For a posterior composite which merely has e, this premise does not deny that q is its quiddity.
